## Summary

Describe the outcome and any intentional non-goals.

## Evidence and scope

Link the issue, source, or evidence this change addresses. List new dependencies, network requests, scheduled behavior, permissions, or secret requirements.

## DCO, rights, and assistance

- [ ] Every human commit is signed off under [DCO.md](../DCO.md).
- [ ] New code is original work or compatible with MIT and correctly attributed.
- [ ] I did not add copied editorial content, scraped/collected data, third-party media, private information, or an asset with unclear rights.
- [ ] I disclosed material AI, model, generator, scraper, or automation assistance below and personally verified the output.

Assistance and verification method, or `None`:

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run public:boundary`
- [ ] `npm run policy:dco`
- [ ] `npm run licenses:check`
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Browser/accessibility checks when visible behavior changed

## Visual evidence

For visible work, include before/after captures and note keyboard, screen-reader, reduced-motion, and responsive checks. Otherwise write `Not applicable`.
